jobs.title: Consultant, Product Manager
jobs.description:
Cardinal Health's Biopharma Solutions business delivers industry-leading technology, analytics, and clinical solutions that support community specialty practices, GPOs, biopharma manufacturers, and healthcare providers. By bringing a modern product mindset to commercial healthcare technology, we establish Cardinal Health as healthcare's most trusted partner.

Our innovation culture powers a comprehensive digital ecosystem. We focus externally on our customers first, integrating multi-disciplinary teams—combining software engineering, data science, and specialty clinical insights—to scale technology that optimizes clinical navigation, accelerates real-world evidence (RWE) generation, and safeguards the financial health of community specialty practices.

Summary
As a Product Manager for Advanced Practice Analytics (APA) within Biopharma Solutions, you will lead the evolution of our premier financial intelligence and reimbursement analytics platform. APA is an enterprise-scale solution designed to deliver insights that optimize specialty practice profitability, formulary selection, and drug purchasing.

Unlike purely clinical platforms, APA is a sophisticated financial engine that delivers critical business insights around specialty formulary management, revenue leakage, buy-and-bill margin optimization, and automated billing reconciliation.

In this role, you will champion an AI-first approach to unlock the value of complex clinical, financial, contract, and claims data. You will help design advanced scenario modeling tools, predictive margin trackers, and modern analytics workflows that help oncology, urology, rheumatology, and gastroenterology practices maintain control over their financial performance and navigate complex drug purchasing environments.

Responsibilities
- Lead Product Strategy & Roadmap: Drive the vision and execution for an AI-first financial intelligence and reimbursement analytics platform. Utilize predictive modeling, machine learning, and automation to turn complex datasets into actionable tools that optimize practice profitability.
- Optimize Practice Economics & Revenue Cycle Management (RCM): Define features for predictive margin tracking, revenue leakage prevention, buy-and-bill margin analysis, and quarterly Average Sales Price (ASP) or reimbursement scenario modeling.
- Drive Platform & Dataset Synergies: Collaborate across product lines to bridge clinical and financial data. Connect APA insights with GPO contract performance, rebate tracking, specialty distribution, and patient hub services to deliver an integrated, best-in-class commercial business suite.
- Execute with Product Excellence: Own the end-to-end product development lifecycle. Translate user needs into robust roadmaps, write high-quality user stories, and maintain a highly prioritized agile backlog that balances value, effort, and technical sustainability.
- Amplify the Voice of the Customer (VOC): Partner with community clinics, practice executives, and clinical/billing staff to understand their daily "jobs to be done." Regularly collaborate with Customer Advisory Boards (CABs) to validate prototypes and ensure rapid product-market fit.

Qualifications
- Experience: 4-8 years of software product management experience, with a proven track record of shipping data-heavy commercial enterprise analytics, financial technology, or B2B SaaS products preferred.
- Specialty Healthcare Knowledge: Strong understanding of specialty practice economics, including "Buy and Bill" mechanics, Average Sales Price (ASP) impact, and therapeutic formulary dynamics.
- Agile Leadership: Expert knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies, continuous product discovery, rapid prototyping, and user experience research.
- Communication & Influence: Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to confidently align engineering, sales, marketing, and practice executives around a shared product vision.
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Healthcare Administration, or equivalent practical experience, preferred.
- Healthcare Data Fluency: Direct experience working with complex clinical, transactional, or contract datasets—such as medical claims and remittance data (e.g., 837/835), GPO contract structures, and clinical-financial data reconciliation, preferred.
- AI/ML & Data Science Literacy: Experience partnering with data scientists or AI engineers to build recommendation engines, natural language processing (NLP) pipelines, or agentic/multi-agent AI workflows, preferred.
- Specialty therapeutic area exposure (e.g., oncology, urology, rheumatology, or gastroenterology), preferred.

Anticipated salary range: $96,300 - $137,600
Bonus eligible: No

Product & Solutions Marketing identifies customer needs and conducts research to inform marketing strategies and offerings. This function supports the teams to drive customer loyalty, sales growth, and improved profitability.

jobs.title: Vice President, Product & Supplier Quality (Medical)
jobs.description:
Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. We offer industry expertise and an expanding portfolio of safe, effective medical products that improve quality, manage costs and reduce complexity. With our trusted regulatory experience, insights, and infrastructure, we help manufacture and source medical products that meet the demand for value-driven, comprehensive healthcare solutions. Cardinal Health is seeking an experienced and transformational Vice President, Product & Supplier Quality to lead quality strategy and execution across our global manufacturing and supplier network. This executive leader will have enterprise-wide responsibility for supplier quality, product quality, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement across 25 global manufacturing sites and an extensive external supplier network.  This role requires a seasoned quality and manufacturing leader with a proven track record of driving quality excellence in highly regulated manufacturing environments. The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker who can anticipate risk, build robust quality systems, strengthen accountability, and ensure operational discipline to prevent quality, compliance, and supply disruptions before they become business-critical events.

Responsibilities:
Enterprise Quality Leadership
- Develop and execute the global product and supplier quality strategy aligned with business objectives, customer expectations, and regulatory requirements.

- Provide executive leadership and oversight for quality operations across 25 global manufacturing facilities and strategic supplier partners.

- Establish a proactive quality culture focused on prevention, risk mitigation, accountability, and continuous improvement.

- Lead enterprise-wide quality governance, management review processes, and quality performance monitoring.

Product Quality & Manufacturing Excellence
- Ensure consistent product quality, reliability, and regulatory compliance across all manufacturing operations.

- Partner with manufacturing leaders to strengthen process controls, quality systems, and operational discipline.

- Drive quality excellence initiatives that improve performance while reducing defects, complaints, nonconformances, and compliance risks.

- Utilize quality metrics and trend analysis to identify emerging risks and implement preventive actions before issues escalate.

Supplier Quality & Risk Management
- Own the global supplier quality program, including supplier qualification, performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Establish robust supplier oversight processes to ensure consistent adherence to quality and regulatory requirements.

- Lead supplier risk management strategies that strengthen supply continuity and reduce business disruption.

- Partner with procurement and supply chain leadership to improve supplier performance and accountability.

Regulatory Compliance & Inspection Readiness
- Ensure compliance with all applicable global regulatory requirements, including FDA, ISO, cGMP, and other international standards.

- Provide leadership for regulatory inspections, audits, responses, and remediation efforts.

- Maintain a state of continuous inspection readiness across all sites and suppliers.

- Escalate significant quality and compliance risks to executive leadership and drive timely resolution.

People Leadership
- Build, develop, and retain a high-performing global quality organization.

- Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, transparency, and employee development.

- Coach leaders to elevate performance and strengthen organizational capabilities.

- Develop robust succession plans and leadership pipelines across the quality function.

- Lead through influence and collaboration while holding teams accountable for outcomes and execution.

Qualifications
- 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Manufacturing, Operations, or Regulatory functions within a regulated industry preferred.

- Significant experience leading quality organizations supporting complex global manufacturing operations.

- Demonstrated success overseeing both Product Quality and Supplier Quality programs.

- Strong understanding of FDA regulations, Quality System Regulations (QSR), cGMP requirements, ISO standards, and global regulatory frameworks.

- Proven experience leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities.

- Track record of developing and implementing enterprise quality strategies that improve performance and reduce risk.

- Exceptional leadership, communication, and executive stakeholder management skills.

- Experience managing large, geographically dispersed teams and complex organizational structures.

- Medical device, healthcare products, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated manufacturing experience.

- Experience leading quality organizations within a global manufacturing footprint.

- Strong Strategic thinker with the ability to anticipate and mitigate risk before issues occur.

- Strong manufacturing mindset with deep understanding of operational realities and quality execution.

- Proven ability to build accountability and performance across large organizations.

- Decisive leader who can balance business needs, quality standards, and regulatory requirements.

- Data-driven decision maker with strong analytical capabilities.

- Collaborative executive capable of influencing across functions and levels.

- Trusted advisor to senior leadership on quality, compliance, and operational risk.

- Passion for developing talent and building high-performing teams.
- Willingness to travel globally as business needs require - roughly 25%.

jobs.title: Senior Analyst, Product Pricing
jobs.description:
At Cardinal Health, we aim to be a trusted partner, offering a broad range of innovative solutions that help our customers provide cost-efficient, more effective healthcare. Join our team of 50,000 humble partners striving each day to make healthcare more efficient, providers more effective, and patients as healthy as possible.

What Product Pricing contributes to Cardinal Health

Revenue Management is responsible for developing, communicating, and leading the execution of market strategy and profitability optimization through pricing and value-capture activities at both the strategic and tactical levels.  The group uses modeling, analytics, and econometrics to create pricing strategies for our products and services.

Product Pricing is responsible for managing price for all dynamically-priced products or services, including setting pricing structure by contract or customer segment and establishing catalog pricings for complex or new-to-Cardinal products and services.  This job family also engages in key acquisitions to assess pricing approach and build enhancements which can be delivered post-close.

Qualifications
- 2-4 years of experience in pricing, preferred
- Bachelor's degree in related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred
- Experience in a commercial team environment and working with business partners.

What is expected of you and others at this level
- Applies working knowledge in the application of concepts, principles and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks
- Works on projects of moderate scope and complexity
- Identifies possible solutions to a variety of technical problems and takes action to resolve
- Applies judgment within defined parameters
- Receives general guidance and may receive more detailed instruction on new projects
- Work reviewed for sound reasoning and accuracy

Responsibilities :
- Manage the pricing process within EMEA region.
- Launch, manage, and maintain Power Apps pricing application for flow of pricing approvals.
- Partner with commercial and finance leaders to align on pricing strategies that drive value for the business.
- Update and maintain pricing tools used by commercial, pricing, and finance teams
- Owns day-to-day escalation management for complex customer and supplier pricing issues, including situations that require coordination across commercial teams, bids and tenders, contracts, pricing council, and finance teams.
- Drives a culture of root cause problem solving, continuous improvement, and process simplification by actively seeking automation opportunities and proactive ways to prevent recurring pricing issues.
- Maintains a strong focus on audit controls, quality assurance, compliance requirements, and operational standards while ensuring employees operate within established guidelines.

The Company
Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health (NYSE: CAH) is a health care services company that improves the cost-effectiveness of healthcare. As the business behind healthcare, Cardinal Health helps pharmacies, hospitals and ambulatory care sites focus on patient care while reducing costs, improving efficiency and quality, and increasing profitability. Cardinal Health is an essential link in the healthcare supply chain, providing pharmaceuticals and medical products to more than 100,000 locations each day and is also the industry-leading direct-to-home medical supplies distributor. The company is a leading manufacturer of medical and surgical products, including gloves, surgical apparel and fluid management products. Ranked #14 on the Fortune 500, Cardinal Health employs more than 40,000 people worldwide. More information about the company may be found at www.cardinalhealth.com
